description: Register a named address entry for connection info like URLs, API endpoints, database connection strings, or service credentials. NOT for storing file content - use blob storage or SSML/audio plugins for files. Auto-ingests to memory for semantic search.
embedding_description: Register an address-book entry binding a logical name to one or more typed fields (URL, API endpoint, database connection string, service credential reference, OAuth client identifier). Named lookup surface for endpoints, paths, service routing, vault references. Backs the address_book_service interface used by peer_claim_role, midwife/undertaker AssumeRole seams, and OAuth client provisioning.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: New address registration with address_id and optional memory_id
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.
